Hi Tom — thanks for reaching out and welcome. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Redwood standard for new suppliers is Net 45 because our billing close and AP cycles are centralized (helps us reconcile monthly commitments).
- We do run early-pay pilots on a case-by-case basis — finance approval required. We typically see offers in the ~0.5%–1% range for early remittance.
- For PO creation we need: legal entity name, remit address, tax ID (EIN), W-9 (US vendors), and a completed onboarding form with bank remit instructions and invoice contact.

If you can send the W-9 and the completed onboarding form I’ll kick off the PO gating. I’ve cc'd David from procurement to confirm whether we can do a split-invoice approach for the first 60 days while finance evaluates any early-pay discount. If you have a preferred PO header template, send it and we’ll map fields to our system.

Next steps:
- You send W-9 + onboarding form (PDF / XLSX)
- Procurement (David) confirms PO gating & any required purchase order notes
- Finance (Karthik) to evaluate early-pay discount pilot

Hi Tom / Olga — looping in procurement voice to confirm PO gating and cadence.

Per Redwood ops: our standard onboarding flow will require a completed onboarding form (received), W-9 (received), and the vendor tax ID for PO registration. Once the vendor is entered we generate a PO with the following notes: our PO system enforces a single currency per PO and requires the invoice contact + remit address. Please confirm the tax ID (EIN) and whether the remit bank is USD or multi-currency.

Regarding terms: Redwood's default net is Net 45 for new vendors aligned to our monthly closes (we close the books on the 2nd and 16th). That said, procurement is okay to propose a staggered approach for onboarding: we can issue an initial PO with Net 45 but split the first month into two milestone invoices so Orchid gets earlier cash flow for part of the work.

On the early-pay 1% proposal — I’ve cc'd Karthik in finance to evaluate. Two asks for you to expedite:
- Confirm EIN in reply
- Confirm the bank currency for remit (USD preferred)

Once finance signs off, procurement will add an AP note to the PO about the early-pay pilot (so AP can route invoices through the expedite queue).
